Description: The list description, encoded in base64
The version of the list published
The difficulty face for the list. -1 = N/A, 0 = Auto, 1 = Easy, 2 = Normal, 3 = Hard, 4 = Harder, 5 = Insane, 6 = Easy Demon, 7 = Medium Demon, 8 = Hard Demon, 9 = Insane Demon, 10 = Extreme Demon
The amount of times the list has been downloaded
If the list is rated or not
The Unix timestamp of when the list was uploaded
The Unix timestamp of when the list was last updated
The account ID of the list author
The username of the list author
All level IDs in the list, separated by commas
The amount of diamonds awarded upon beating the required amount of levels in the list
The amount of levels needed to claim the list reward
